# Creamy Tomato Soup

![Recipe image]({{ORIGIN}}/all_image/recipes/96/96977/recipe_882e87ee-8656-49c5-beff-09a91888536e_w450.webp)

A simple creamy tomato soup.

## Ingredients
- 2 tomatoes
- 1 onion

## Instructions
1. Chop the tomatoes and onion.

   ![Step 1]({{ORIGIN}}/steps/step-1.webp)
2. Simmer until soft.
